verdict.rationale: Docs describe the Customer Agent handling tickets end-to-end across channels (Intercom, Zendesk, Pylon, etc.) and claim its agents 'resolve tickets across email, live chat, and Slack,' implying genuine resolution rather than mere deflection. However, there are no quantified resolution rates, case studies, or independent benchmarks showing what share of conversations are fully resolved without human intervention. Missing for 10: quantified resolution/deflection metrics, customer case studies or third-party validation of resolution rates, and clarity on how many tickets require human approval/escalation versus full autonomous resolution.
